_meta.title: July 2026 frontier-model sandbox escape - complete public record
_meta.curated_by: Apocalypse team (Track 1, AI Incident Response Sprint 2026-09)
_meta.note: This IS the machine-readable dataset. The HF 'replay' ships no JSON/CSV/IOC/YARA. Its entire data payload is 9 phase totals, 5 day counts, and a handful of example commands, extracted here verbatim. Any plan to 'mine the 17,600-action corpus' is impossible: that corpus is not public. Curating this file is itself a contribution.
_meta.reconstruction_gap_note: phase totals sum to 16521 (the v1 curation of this file omitted the supply-chain phase, 69 actions, and undercounted at 16452 - fixed here); day counts sum to ~17613. HF recovered a subset via decoding replication. The gap is public-record evidence, cite it in limitations.
